description: This source file contains a PHP class named 'Marketing' that extends the base Controller class in OpenCart. The class provides methods for displaying marketing reports, saving report settings, and generating report data. It manages user permissions, retrieves data from models, formats output as views or JSON, and handles pagination and filters for marketing-related reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Marketing

methods.description: Prepares and displays the main report page with filtering, pagination, and report data.
